name: Magazine Editorial Satin Sweet
image_purpose: fashion magazine and confectionery campaign image

prompt.project_info: Create a modern coquette glamour editorial with pastel satin, pearls, cake, and polished gold accents.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman in a pastel-pink satin cowl-neck dress, slim rectangular sunglasses, gold hoop earrings, and layered pearl necklaces holds small pieces of cake in both hands with a composed, playful expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Symmetrical medium close-up, solid seamless pastel-pink background, cake on the table, silver dessert goblet, pearl strands and gold accessories arranged as tactile props, face and sunglasses as the focal point.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal butterfly studio lighting, high-key exposure, minimal harsh shadows, gentle glow on shoulders, dreamy highlight bloom and low grain.
prompt.technical_specs: High-clarity editorial portrait, shallow depth of field, realistic satin sheen, polished gold, pearls, cake texture, and natural skin detail; leave optional typography space in the background.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Modern coquette glamour editorial medium close-up of an adult woman in a pastel-pink satin cowl-neck dress, slim generic rectangular sunglasses, gold hoop earrings, and layered pearl necklaces, holding small pieces of cake in both hands. Symmetrical composition against a seamless pastel-pink background, cake and silver dessert goblet on the table, pearl strands and gold accessories as props, soft frontal butterfly lighting, high-key gentle glow, dreamy highlights, low grain, fashion magazine quality.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, recognizable eyewear logo, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, messy food splatter, watermark, signature, illegible text
